race.title: AWC Trials Day - Lingfield 2nd Jan 2027 Fillies' Handicap
race.verdict: Preference is for ZOOELLA , who resumed her progress with a decisive victory at Southwell last month. She is fancied to record a fourth win of the year with more still to offer, though Startling isn't taken lightly after readily making all at Chelmsford on her latest outing, while Rajiba could go well back down in trip. ZOOELLA (IRE) STARTLING RAJIBA
race.bettingForecast: Startling (13/8), Zooella (9/4), Rajiba (4/1), Moostar (7/1), Moonlight Mirage (10/1)
